channel.title: AI GridWatch — Minnesota data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Minnesota, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Inver Grove Heights: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium, 3-2; freezes a proposed 55,000 sq ft / 5 MW project while staff study zoning, water and noise impacts. Developer QLevr has threatened a \$150M lawsuit

item.title: Minneapolis: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 6-month moratorium on data centers >350,000 sq ft, 8-5. Downtown core exempt. Zoning ordinance updates and environmental impact report due during the pause

item.title: Eagan: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium on data centers >20 MW or within 500 ft of residential, first MN city to pause. Under legal challenge — developer filed suit Jun 15 alleging city lacks authority to regulate electricity demand

item.title: Carver: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium, unanimous. Proactive — no pending data center project at time of vote

item.title: Wright County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Emergency 1-year moratorium (Ord. 26-2), unanimous. Applies to unincorporated areas only. Moratorium Workgroup formed Jun 16 to evaluate environmental, fiscal, infrastructure, and land use considerations

item.title: Washington County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium on new data center applications in unincorporated areas, 4-1. Extended from originally proposed 6-month pause

item.title: Minneapolis: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 6-month interim ordinance; facilities over 350,000 sq ft, downtown exempt
